newsitem.title: UK: Pearson sells stake in Hong Kong's TVB. [CORRECTED 14:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Pearson sells stake in Hong Kong's TVB. [CORRECTED 14:55 GMT]

text.p: British media and leisure group Pearson Plc said on Friday it sold its entire 10 percent stake in Hong Kong's Television Broadcasts Ltd for 111.1 million pounds ($180.1 million).
The company said Shaw Brothers (Hong Kong) Ltd and an associated party bought the shares.
Pearson bought its stake in TVB in February 1995 for about 106.2 million (corrects from 103.6 million) stg, or HK$31 per share, and received dividends during the period of 3.5 million stg.
The final sale price was HK$33.25, Pearson said.

"Our commitment to the growth of our businesses in Asia/Pacific is as strong as ever, but we have decided that this investment is no longer effective in developing either our television business or our interests in the region," Pearson chief executive Marjorie Scardino said in a statement.
However, Pearson said it would continue in its Indian joint venture with TVB, the Hindustan Times, Carlton Communications Plc and Schroders Plc.
That TV channel, Home TV, began transmitting to satellite viewers last year and was meeting forecasts, Pearson said.
